Ruling: batch #167 item 2 · 剥 (the objectui#9571 strip is applied to the legacy `props` alias bag as well — the same arm predicate `recordSourceDataArmForType(type) === 'view-data'`, the same dev diagnostic — so an authored `props: { data }` loses the prop seat exactly as top-level `data` and `properties: { data }` already do; ⛔ no validator refusal, ⛔ no change to what the alias otherwise carries) · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T15:17Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation 剥; the maintainer agreed.

Facts re-read at source by the director: the strip runs on `componentProps` (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:1970`) and `...outgoingPropsBag` is spread after it, so the legacy bag is the one carrier that ruling objectui#8348 Q2-C / objectui#9571 did not reach. The card's two unmeasured items were measured here: (i) validator — `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()` (`packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts:474`) and `props` is declared on no zod mirror, on no TypeScript `BaseSchema` member and nowhere in `packages/core/src/validation/schema-validator.ts`: nothing refuses the spelling today; it is a channel only the renderer reads. (ii) end-to-end — a `data` in the prop seat is lifted by the object-arm blocks' unconditional `Array.isArray` at higher priority than the `schema.data` ladder, the mechanism objectui#9571 closed; the second carrier is the same defect one alias over.

⛔ 拒 (the validator refuses `props`): that is whether the `props` alias exists at all — objectui#4795 pending question ②, human-held; a p2 carrier does not narrow a published authoring surface on the way past. ⛔ Not `pm:blocked` on #4795: a card that is itself blocked and human-held is not a condition that matures.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:ui`, `priority:p2` stay. Change: in the `createElement` path the outgoing legacy bag passes through the same `data`-on-the-object-arm strip as `componentProps` — one predicate, one diagnostic (`reportRefusedDataPropSpread`), no second copy of the arm test. Tests: the card's three-spelling probe becomes the positive controls (`props: { data }` now absent; top-level and `properties` still absent) plus a host-prop control (`<SchemaRenderer data={rows}/>` still delivers rows — the host path is the ruled half and stays untouched). The `ListView.tsx:2976` object-gantt note stays outside this card. Clause-②: no (no published type or accept set moves).

**Premise re-measured at source**, `origin/main` `d6a84446f` at 2026-09-18T20:09Z: the strip sits on `componentProps` at `:1968`–`:1975` (`'data' in componentProps` → `outgoingComponentProps = withoutAuthoredData`), and the legacy alias bag is spread after it — the file's own comment at `:1864` already says the neighbouring scan reads 「`componentProps`, NOT the narrower bag the objectui#9571 strip」.

⭐ **RULED — this is execution, ⛔ not a decision.** Batch #167 item 2, letter **剥**, maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T15:17Z (`5732098890`). The ruling also **measured the card's two unmeasured items**: the validator refuses nothing (`BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`, `props` is declared on no zod mirror and nowhere in `schema-validator.ts`), and end-to-end a `data` in the prop seat is lifted by the object-arm blocks' unconditional `Array.isArray` ahead of the `schema.data` ladder. ⇒ ⛔ 拒 (a validator refusal) is explicitly OUT: that question is objectui#4795's, human-held.
